verdict.rationale: Yubico ships programmatic surfaces, the YubiCloud OTP validation API and the YubiEnterprise REST API, so a sandbox environment is a fair question here. The evidence explicitly says demo.yubico.com is a browser demo for registering and testing keys, 'not an API sandbox with test credentials', and that YubiCloud OTP offers only production Client IDs. The documented local development setup is a user-side arrangement, not a vendor-provided sandbox, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
